title: About Me
text: Supply Chain Analyst with 4+ years of experience driving measurable improvements in forecasting, procurement, and logistics. Delivered 12% forecast accuracy gain, 8% transportation cost reduction, lowered carrying costs $3.2M, and optimized on-time delivery from 87% to 93%.

Skilled in SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, SAP, Oracle SCM, NetSuite, cost-to-serve analysis, supplier performance management, ESG compliance, and data analytics. Experienced in sustainability reporting, supplier compliance, and cross-functional collaboration across procurement, logistics, and finance to support efficient global supply chain operations.
